<p class="profile-name">Giada Durante</p>

I am a PhD candidate in Finance at the **Ross School of Business, University of Michigan**. My research focuses on macro finance and climate finance, and in particular on the interaction between regulatory policies and capital markets in the context of climate-related issues.

I hold a BSc in Economics and Business from Luiss University and a Double Degree MSc in Finance and Quantitative Techniques jointly awarded by Luiss University and the Qtem Network. Before my PhD, I worked as a financial analyst at a financial advisory firm in Milan and as a Monetary Policy trainee in the Capital Markets division at the European Central Bank.

Outside of academia, I am a certified scuba diver and passionate traveler!
